title: Flaky-Test Detection and Stabilization
description: Detect inconsistent browser-test outcomes through bounded repeated runs and verify reviewed stabilization without hiding failures.
setup_prompt: Use Flaky-Test Detection and Stabilization for this browser test. Repeat the exact case under controlled profiles, preserve passing and failing evidence, classify the instability, and verify only reviewed stabilization changes without quarantining or weakening the test.

setup_inputs.label: Repetition, order, concurrency, and profile policy
Allowed test paths and required related cases

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks managed agent-browser
recommended_tools.purpose: Investigate differing states and collect supported diagnostics

recommended_tools.name: GitHub CLI or MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Read change context or publish an explicitly authorized stabilization review

pulse_focus.label: Technical review
focus_areas: Reproduction rate, variance, and stabilization proof
review_when: A run fails, produces incomplete evidence, or a key metric becomes unreliable

pulse_focus.label: Architecture review
focus_areas: Sources of nondeterminism, test isolation, and fixture design
Ownership of flaky-test history and evidence
review_when: The workflow, integration, environment, scale, or operating policy changes materially

pulse_focus.label: Strategic review
focus_areas: Business cost of instability and prioritization policy
Whether stabilization effort improves delivery confidence
review_when: Outcome metrics regress, priorities change, or the current approach needs periodic challenge
